The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: BDP 05: CLUSTERING OF LARGE UNLABELED DATASETS OVERVIEW Real world data is frequently unlabeled and can seem completely random.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: In these sort of situations, unsupervised learning techniques are a great way to find underlying patterns.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: This project looks at one such algorithm, KMeans clustering, which searches for boundaries separating groups of points based on their differences in some features.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: The goal of the project is to implement an unsupervised clustering algorithm using a distributed computing platform.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: You will implement this algorithm on the stack overflow user base to find different ways the community can be divided, and investigate what causes these groupings.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: The clustering algorithm must be designed in a way that is appropriate for data intensive parallel computing frameworks.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: Spark would be the primary choice for this project, but it could also be implemented in Hadoop MapReduce.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: Algorithm implementations from external libraries such as Spark MLib may not be utilised; the code must be original from the students.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: However, once the algorithm is completed, a comparison between your own results and that generated by MLlib could be interesting and aid your investigation.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: Stack Overflow is the main dataset for this project, but alternative datasets can be adopted after consultation with the module organiser.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: Additionally, different clustering algorithms may be utilised, but this must be discussed and approved y the module organiser.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: DATASET The project will use the Stack Overflow dataset.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: This dataset is located in HDFS at /data/stackoverflow The dataset for StackOverflow is a set of files containing Posts, Users, Votes, Comments, PostHistory and PostLinks.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: Each file contains one XML record per line.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: For complete schema information: Click here In order to define the clustering use case, you must define what should be the features of each post that will be used to cluster the data.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: Have a look at the different fields to define your use case.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: ALGORITHM The project will implement the k-means algorithm for clustering.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: This algorithm iteratively recomputes the location of k centroids (k is the number of clusters, defined beforehand), that aim to classify the data.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: Points are labelled to the closest centroid, with each iteration updating the centroids location based on all the points labelled with that value.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: Spark and Map/Reduce can be utilised for implementing this problem.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: Spark is recommended for this task, due to its performance benefits in .
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: However, note that the MLib extension of Spark is not allowed to be used as the primary implementation.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: The group must code its own original implementation of the algorithm.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: However, it is possible to also use the mllib implementation, in order to evaluate the results from each clustering implementation.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: Report Contents Brief literature survey on clustering algorithms, including the challenges on implementing them at scale for parallel frameworks.
The record for GroupAYECS765P/BDP-05-Large-scale-Clustering states in its own description: The report should then justify the chosen algorithm (if changed) and the implementation.
